title: Remove all customer-facing 'Serving Ontario' service-area copy

requirements.text: Remove customer-facing service-area text that mentions Ontario (including the phrase "Serving Ontario") wherever it appears in the storefront UI.
acceptanceCriteria: No customer-facing text contains "Ontario" or the phrase "Serving Ontario" in the header, hero, footer, or other storefront pages.
A search across the frontend source for the string "Ontario" returns no remaining customer-facing copy (excluding non-user-facing/internal identifiers if any).

requirements.text: Update the shared service-area copy constant and any dependent UI so the resulting sentences render with correct English punctuation/grammar after removing Ontario.
acceptanceCriteria: Header subtitle renders cleanly without Ontario.
Storefront hero paragraph that interpolates the service-area copy reads naturally (no doubled periods, extra spaces, or trailing punctuation issues).
Footer company description no longer states it is serving Ontario and reads naturally in English.

constraints: Do not modify files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose read-only UI components only).
Keep the footer "Contact Us" section phone-only (do not add email/address/service-area lines there).
nonGoals: Do not add new regions or replacement geography copy unless required to remove Ontario mentions.
Do not change backend behavior, data models, or APIs.
